title: Synthesis, Structure and Luminescence Characterizations of Pyramid-like Lanthanide-Titanium-Oxo Clusters EuTi9 and TbTi9

synthesis.procedure: Prepared solvothermally from Eu(acac)3·H2O, titanium isopropoxide and 2-thiophenecarboxylic acid in acetonitrile and tetrahydrofuran at 80 °C. The main text gives no numerical reagent quantities.

properties.summary: Weak red Eu(III)-characteristic luminescence under ultraviolet excitation. The solid-state emission intensity decreases with increasing temperature and shows a reported linear temperature dependence.

measurements.name: Emission peaks
measurements.conditions: Solid state, room temperature; excitation at 309 nm

measurements.name: Temperature sensitivity
measurements.conditions: Maximum emission intensity of the Eu(III) 5D0→7F2 transition; temperature-dependent measurement between 80 and 320 K

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The ten-metal core has a three-layer pyramidal arrangement: Eu occupies the apex, four Ti ions form the middle layer and five Ti ions form the bottom layer. Oxide and hydroxide bridges connect the metals; isopropoxide, acetylacetonate, TCA and THF ligands protect the core.

synthesis.procedure: Prepared solvothermally from Tb(acac)3, titanium isopropoxide and 2-thiophenecarboxylic acid in acetonitrile and tetrahydrofuran at 80 °C. The main text gives no numerical reagent quantities.

properties.summary: Weak green Tb(III)-characteristic luminescence under ultraviolet excitation. Emission intensity decreases with increasing temperature; the reported temperature sensitivity varies across three intervals.

measurements.name: Emission peaks
measurements.conditions: Solid state, room temperature; excitation at 300 nm

measurements.name: Temperature sensitivity, first interval
measurements.conditions: Maximum emission intensity of the Tb(III) 5D4→7F5 transition; first of three intervals in the 80–320 K measurement

measurements.name: Temperature sensitivity, second interval
measurements.conditions: Maximum emission intensity of the Tb(III) 5D4→7F5 transition; second interval

measurements.name: Temperature sensitivity, third interval
measurements.conditions: Maximum emission intensity of the Tb(III) 5D4→7F5 transition; third interval

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The article identifies TbTi9 as structurally similar to the separately characterized EuTi9 pyramidal cluster, but describes the Eu analogue in detail rather than independently assigning each Tb-site position.
